summary: British American Tobacco p.l.c. filed a Form 6-K on October 7, 2026, disclosing a new phase of its ongoing share buyback program. The company entered a repurchase agreement with Merrill Lynch International to buy ordinary shares from October 13 through December 23, 2026, with trading decisions made independently by the broker. Purchases fall under shareholder authority granted at the 2026 AGM for up to 217,492,219 shares and UK Listing Rules. Repurchased shares will be cancelled to reduce share capital, with the maximum price capped at 105% of the five-day average market value. The filing provides no fixed price or aggregate value; watch execution pace, liquidity, and cancellation impact on EPS accretion.
